name: Gravel V3 2024 RS / Sensah 2×12 alloy

editorial.verdict: This discontinued 2024 V3 build paired mechanical 2×12 and hydraulic braking with 38 mm alloy wheels. It was superseded by the 2025 Gravel V3; the retained ¥3,991 observation is historical and does not describe other wheel selections.
strengths: Carbon frame, fork, and cockpit package at an unusually low complete-bike price
caveats: No longer sold new; any used example or remaining stock needs independent condition and provenance checks
Older press-fit frame generation rather than the later T47 V3
The exact-model manual publishes a 40C maximum, but measured clearance still depends on the installed rim and tire
The reused Taobao page has conflicting size graphics and warns that exact component batches can vary

drivetrain.front_derailleur: Microshift in one table; RS in another reused graphic

wheels.description: Seller-listed 38 mm double-wall aluminum wheelset; separate from the optional approximately 50 mm carbon-wheel selection

claimed_complete_weight_basis: Seller-listed complete-bike weight for the exact alloy-wheel selection; size, pedals and accessories were not stated
purchase_route: No longer sold new; superseded by the 2025 Gravel V3. Treat the Taobao page only as legacy product evidence. Used examples or claimed remaining stock need independent SKU, condition, and provenance checks.
